name: figma-reader-mvp
description: Explore local Figma .fig files, inspect layers and design tokens, and share precise context with AI agents through MCP.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,viewer -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @figma-reader/server" "npm run start -w figma-reader"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @figma-reader/fig-engine && npm run build -w @figma-reader/server && npm run build -w figma-reader
scripts.test: npm run test -w @figma-reader/server && npm run test -w figma-reader -- --watch=false
